PagerDutyBot: :rotating_light: HIGH: error-rate-5xx on api-gateway-us-west. Rolling 1m error rate 22% for /v1/chat and multiple timeouts. Pager: pages sent to @Maya.

Maya (oncall): ack. Jumping in.

Raj (sre): can confirm from traces. Large burst of fanout requests causing prefix lookup amplification against kv-prefix-store (shard id: s-22). Backend request queue backs up -> gateway 504s.

Evelyn (eng-infra): pulling shard metrics and logs now. s-22 p50 read = 410ms (baseline 9ms), p99 > 4s. Eviction_rate spiked alongside a surge in prefix fanout events. Memory usage at 96%.

Sam (prod-ops): reporting symptom: several customer integrations receiving intermittent 502/504s, err count ~2.4k in last 12m. Notifying account owners for degraded integrations.

Maya (oncall): immediate mitigations? Prioritize actions that reduce load on s-22 without losing critical traffic.

Raj (sre): plan: 1) enable read-through bypass for prefix-paths to fallback cold-store (ttl 600s), 2) apply temporary per-prefix rate limit for heavy fanout signatures, 3) spin an extra read-replica for s-22 if bypass insufficient. Start with bypass.

Evelyn (eng-infra): bypass flag name: `prefix.kv.read_through_disabled` for service namespace `prefix-map`. I can flip with rollout command. Applying rate-limit rule alongside to block extreme fanout signatures.

Maya (oncall): do it. Also, increase gateway upstream timeout to 30s for slow flows while we stabilize.

DeployBot: noted: recent change to model-router at 6088881102 — correlating.

Evelyn (eng-infra): executing now:

```
opsctl flags set --name prefix.kv.read_through_disabled --ns prefix-map --value true --ttl 600s
opsctl ratelimit add --route "/v1/chat" --match "fanout_signature:long_prefix" --limit 60/s
```

Evelyn (eng-infra): gateway timeout bumped.

Raj (sre): seeing immediate effect: backend request rate to s-22 down ~78%. 5xx rate dropped 22% -> 7% within 90s. p50 latency trending down.

Sam (prod-ops): customer error counts decreasing. Still some residual failures for long-tail prefixes.

Maya (oncall): good. Maintain bypass while Raj inspects prefix index integrity. Can we run a non-invasive scan?

Raj (sre): will run index-hash-check with throttling. Starting in background with conservative rate.

```
kv-tool scan-prefix-index --shard s-22 --mode safe --rate 80/s --emit=anomalies
```

Raj (sre): scanner found irregular pointer chains for ~0.03% of entries (loops and stale refs). Not a full blob corruption but pointer churn that can cause exponential fanout under concurrent reads.

Evelyn (eng-infra): echo. Also observed a sudden bloom filter saturation on s-22 which worsens miss amplification. Likely a combined effect of pointer churn + bloom saturation.

Maya (oncall): options: 1) patch traversal to detect and drop loops (fast, local patch), 2) rebuild affected prefix segments (safer but heavy), 3) keep bypass + add circuit breaker and schedule rebuild during low traffic window. Which do we pick?

Raj (sre): prefer patch traversal now to stop the loops quickly; follow with a controlled rebuild for affected segments overnight. Patch is small and can be staged to canary. I'll craft a 1-file change that checks depth and drops stale ref if loop detected. Canary + rollout target s-22 replica.

Evelyn (eng-infra): I can spin a temporary read replica to reduce risk during canary. Kickoff now.

```
infractl replicas add --shard s-22 --count 1 --type read
```

Evelyn (eng-infra): replica added, sync 45s.

Raj (sre): deploying patch to canary (replica only): estimate 18-25m including canary validation. Keeping bypass on until patch confirmed.

Maya (oncall): customer impact update: initial window ~14m, ~2.4k errors, top accounts notified. Sam, please update the incident slack banner and support ticket template.

Sam (prod-ops): updating now. Drafted note: "We observed elevated 5xx/timeouts due to a prefix-index inconsistency causing cache miss amplification. We applied temporary bypass and rate limits; a targeted fix is being deployed. We will follow up with root cause and timeline for full rebuild."

DeployBot: canary deploy started for `kv-prefix-traversal-fix` on s-22-replica at 6088881320.

Raj (sre): canary metrics look good for 5min. No abnormal errors, traversal loops prevented in canary logs. Rolling to remaining replicas with 2-step rollout.

Evelyn (eng-infra): rolling now.

Raj (sre): patch fully rolled 25m after start. Observed drop in residual tail errors. p99 read latency down significantly.

Maya (oncall): great work. Keep bypass in place for another 10m and then revert to validate.

Evelyn (eng-infra): scheduling revert of `prefix.kv.read_through_disabled` in 10m unless we see regression. Also filing infra follow-ups: add circuit-breaker and early-warning metric for bloom saturation. Ticket: INFRA-pp-4721.

Sam (prod-ops): incident summary being compiled. No SEV declared, but we will close with P1 postmortem if customer impact >1k errors and multiple integrations affected (meets threshold).

Maya (oncall): handing off to Raj for post-deploy monitoring and to lead the RCA writeup. I'll go to watch mode. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

Raj (sre): ack. Will post final status when bypass is reverted and metrics stable for 30m.

Maya (oncall): closing pager.
